entities.summary: Abdullah Moussa Al-Mayhoub, also known as Abdelallah Moussa El-myehoub was a member of the Libyan National Transitional Council representing the city of Al Qubah. He received a Doctor of Philosophy from a university in France and previously served as Dean of the law school at Benghazi University.
